row.notes: In Game_GrandPrixContinueVm_PressEntry (0x141bce150), the continue_solo_gp_f1w_offline_warning check: cmp [rax+0x580],rcx; sete dil; test rcx,rcx; jne 0x141bcee7c; xor edi,edi; xor dil,1. Reached by fall-through from mov rcx,[r14] at 0x141bcee67 only; no branch lands in 0x141bcee6b..0x141bcee70. rax = the F1 World player component ([rsp+0x70] from 0x14032f810 at 0x141bcee4d, non-null: test rax,rax at 0x141bcee57, je 0x141bcee9f at 0x141bcee60); r14 = the save's GameSetupMode, the entry of the mode entity's vt+0x1d0 list (0x141bceaa4) whose +0x80 id equals slot+0xa8 (0x141bceac3); rcx = [r14], its vehicle category; [rsp+0x48] = the mode entity (stored at 0x141bceb8b). dil = 1 (no match) jumps on to 0x141bce788 at 0x141bceefd; dil = 0 offline shows the warning at 0x141bcef28. rcx is written before any read on both ways (0x141bceebe, 0x141bceee4, 0x141bce788). Core's GP continue guard sets rcx to 0 when [rax+0x580] is not the category of the setup mode labelled f1_world: sete gives 0, the null test clears edi and the xor leaves dil 1, the game's own no-match result. EA 0x141bc92da (function 0x141bc85c0, all 875 instructions identical).

V9258 Re-check of the corrected row after V9257: the null test now cites test rax,rax at 0x141bcee57 and je 0x141bcee9f at 0x141bcee60, which matches the disassembly; all other claims re-derived as in V9257 and still hold. Guard code native/src/core/guards/frontend/gp_continue_guard.cpp warning_check reads component=rax, mode=r14, setup=rcx, entity=[c->rsp+0x48] (SwoftyContext.rsp is the site rsp, trampoline_rsp is separate), calls the entity's vt+0x1d0 with only rcx as at 0x141bceaa4, walks +8..+0x10 as 8-byte pointers, takes [mode] as the category. check() zeroes rcx only on decide()==skip, i.e. setup!=0, [rax+0x580]==setup and an f1_world category that is found and differs; a failed component read or a missing f1_world mode leaves rcx unchanged. Not verified: that vt+0x1d0 has no side effects (the game calls it with no other args and reads +8/+0x10 straight away).
